head: Phagosome maturation and its mycobacterial subversion
name: Phagosome maturation and its mycobacterial subversion (acidification, phagolysosome fusion, host defence evasion)
rationale: Members cover phagosome/endosome acidification and lysosome fusion together with the Mycobacterium tuberculosis strategies that block them and other host defences, which separates the theme from the toxin and bacterial-entry confusables.

head: Endocannabinoid retrograde synaptic signaling
name: Endocannabinoid retrograde synaptic signaling (diacylglycerol hydrolysis)
rationale: Diacylglycerol breakdown supplies 2-AG for retrograde lipid signaling at synapses, distinct from the DAG/TAG synthesis and neuropeptide confusables.

head: Cardiac outflow tract morphogenesis
name: Cardiac outflow tract morphogenesis (great and coronary arteries, semilunar valves, neural crest migration)
rationale: Members shape the arterial pole of the heart (pharyngeal arch, pulmonary and coronary arteries, aortic and pulmonary valves, outflow septation by neural crest), unlike the atrioventricular cushion and heart-tube confusables.

head: Nuclear RNA synthesis and processing
name: Nuclear RNA synthesis and processing (RNA polymerase I/III transcription, pre-mRNA splicing, nuclear RNA decay)
rationale: Members transcribe rRNA, tRNA and snRNA and process and degrade nuclear transcripts including splicing and histone pre-mRNA processing, distinguishing them from the translation, mRNA export and RNA modification confusables.

head: Glomerular vasculature development
name: Glomerular vasculature development (mesangial cells, endothelium)
rationale: All members build the glomerular capillary tuft through mesangial and endothelial development, whereas confusables concern general control of kidney growth and nephron tubules.

head: CFTR-mediated epithelial chloride and water transport
name: CFTR-mediated epithelial chloride and water transport (cystic fibrosis, CFTR trafficking)
rationale: Members concern CFTR-driven transepithelial fluid secretion, its trafficking and its loss in cystic fibrosis, unlike the SLC26, bicarbonate and cation-chloride transporter confusables.

head: Plasma membrane lipid asymmetry and integrity
name: Plasma membrane lipid asymmetry and integrity (flippases and scramblases, membrane repair, mechanical stress response)
rationale: Members control phospholipid flipping and scrambling and the plasma membrane's response to pressure, stretch, blebbing and damage, separating it from apoptotic-cell clearance and ER lipid-transfer confusables; one mitochondrial housekeeping module fits only loosely.

head: DNA replication initiation and elongation
name: DNA replication initiation and elongation (primer synthesis, polymerase switching, Okazaki flap removal)
rationale: Members are the core steps of replicative DNA synthesis from priming through lagging-strand maturation, unlike the translesion synthesis, repair and cell-cycle confusables.

head: Lipoyl dehydrogenase complexes and CoA supply
name: Lipoyl dehydrogenase complexes and CoA supply (pyruvate and 2-oxoglutarate dehydrogenases, protein lipoylation, pantothenate)
rationale: Members are the lipoylated PDH, OGDH, OADH and glycine cleavage complexes that make acyl-CoAs plus coenzyme A synthesis from pantothenate, while confusables centre on branched-chain catabolism, vitamin B6 or the TCA cycle.

head: Ubiquitin chain assembly and editing
name: Ubiquitin chain assembly and editing (linkage-specific chains, deubiquitinases, E1-E2-E3 enzymes)
rationale: Members build and trim K6/K11/K27/K29/K48/K63 and branched ubiquitin chains via the E1-E2-E3 cascade and DUB families, unlike the proteasome, proteostasis, neddylation and NF-kappaB confusables.

head: Cell-cycle DNA replication initiation and control
name: Cell-cycle DNA replication initiation and control (ATR replication-stress checkpoint, E2F targets)
rationale: Members start and restrain S-phase DNA replication including the ATR replication checkpoint, which separates the theme from the pre-replicative complex, G1/S and unwinding confusables.

head: Phosphate homeostasis and mineralization
name: Phosphate homeostasis and mineralization (bone and teeth, ectopic calcification, phosphate transporters)
rationale: Members link phosphate transport and parathyroid-hormone responses to bone, dentin and enamel mineralization and ectopic calcification disorders, unlike the FGF23-Klotho and type II Na/Pi cotransporter confusables.

head: Classical cadherin protein-level regulation
name: Classical cadherin protein-level regulation (E-cadherin trafficking and degradation, cadherin-11 interactions)
rationale: Members govern E-cadherin processing, trafficking and degradation and cadherin-11 binding at the protein level, unlike confusables on junction assembly, desmosomes or cadherin gene transcription.

head: Ascorbate metabolism and thyroid hormonogenesis
name: Ascorbate metabolism and thyroid hormonogenesis (vitamin C transport, hydrogen peroxide, iodide uptake)
rationale: Ascorbate/vitamin E handling and peroxide-dependent thyroid hormone generation share only a loose redox link, and the pair separates the theme from iron/ROS detoxification and thyroid-receptor signaling confusables.

head: SUMOylation of nuclear proteins
name: SUMOylation of nuclear proteins (chromatin regulators, transcription cofactors, RNA-binding proteins)
rationale: All members are SUMO conjugation of nuclear substrate classes, and chromatin, cofactor and RNA-binding targets distinguish it from confusables on SUMO processing, replication and nuclear-envelope substrates.

head: Hedgehog ligand maturation and release
name: Hedgehog ligand maturation and release (autoprocessing, palmitoylation, ERAD of mutants)
rationale: Members describe Hedgehog precursor self-cleavage, lipidation, quality control and secretion, unlike the general lipidation, Wnt biogenesis and Notch glycosylation confusables.

head: Gonadotropin control of gonadal function
name: Gonadotropin control of gonadal function (ovulation and luteinization, testis development, gonadotropin secretion)
rationale: Members tie LH/FSH secretion to ovarian cycling and Sertoli/Leydig testis development, separating it from oocyte-maturation, activin/AMH and antral-follicle confusables.

head: Regulation of endocytic uptake
name: Regulation of endocytic uptake (receptor internalization, caveolae and rafts, pinocytosis)
rationale: Members control entry of receptors and fluid into the cell via clathrin, caveolar and pinocytic routes, while confusables concern recycling or lysosomal degradation of internalized receptors.

head: tRNA maturation and aminoacylation
name: tRNA maturation and aminoacylation (nuclear tRNA processing, selenocysteine, translational fidelity)
rationale: Members process, modify and charge cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNAs to keep decoding accurate, with nuclear processing and selenocysteine/readthrough distinguishing it from the RNA modification and mitochondrial gene expression confusables.

head: ER protein biogenesis and export
name: ER protein biogenesis and export (cotranslational targeting, quality control, COPII/COPI traffic)
rationale: Members follow secretory proteins from SRP and tail-anchored insertion through ER folding and quality control to COPII export and COPI retrieval, unlike the Golgi/endosome traffic and membrane insertion confusables.

head: Histone-modifying transcriptional coregulator complexes
name: Histone-modifying transcriptional coregulator complexes (lysine and arginine methyltransferases, CHD-NuRD remodellers, RUNX1 cofactors)
rationale: Members are coregulator complexes that methylate histones or remodel chromatin for transcription factors, distinct from the DNA methylation, PRC2 and deacetylase confusables.

head: Mitochondrial 2-oxoacid catabolism
name: Mitochondrial 2-oxoacid catabolism (branched-chain amino acids, 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes, lipoyl and biotin cofactors)
rationale: Members oxidize pyruvate, 2-oxoglutarate, 2-oxoadipate and branched-chain keto acids with their lipoate, biotin and CoA cofactors and the organic acidemias they cause, unlike the beta-oxidation, vitamin B6 and TCA/iron-sulfur confusables.

head: Ubiquitin-dependent growth factor receptor downregulation
name: Ubiquitin-dependent growth factor receptor downregulation (EGF receptor, endocytosis, multivesicular body sorting)
rationale: Members internalize ubiquitinated receptors such as EGFR and MET and sort them to lysosomes, unlike the ESCRT viral budding and MET/PTK6 signaling confusables.

head: Skeletal muscle development and contraction
name: Skeletal muscle development and contraction (sarcomere assembly, neuromuscular junction, dystrophin-glycoprotein complex)
rationale: Members build and run skeletal muscle fibres including sarcomeres, NMJ clustering and the dystrophin complex, unlike the calcineurin/atrophy and cardiac junction confusables.

head: Axon pathfinding of major tracts
name: Axon pathfinding of major tracts (commissural midline crossing, corticospinal and optic tracts, monoaminergic axons)
rationale: Members guide specific long axon tracts and midline crossing, whereas confusables are defined by the signaling pathways (netrin, SLIT-ROBO, ephrin, L1) rather than the tracts.
